metadata.title: Week 6 Progress
metadata.narration_policy: Narration is SCRIPT.md verbatim, one script section per beat: B00 = section 1, B01-B06 = sections 2-7, BOUT = section 8.
metadata.visual_policy: Simple illustrative Manim cards in the humanitarians palette, in the same style as the Week 3 progress video. No photos or recordings of the fellow, no person icons, no real company, product or tool logos. No Google, reCAPTCHA or Cloudflare logos and no screenshots of real challenge pages: a CAPTCHA is shown only as a plain drawn grid of squares, and Claude Code as a generic drawn terminal. Tools named in the narration are generic drawn shapes or plain text. Any file, terminal or video frame shown is drawn, not a screenshot. Every shape is an illustration of what the script says, not real data.
metadata.structure_note: Same structure as the Week 3 progress video: Claude composer cold open, six body cards, logo outro. No hesitant-writer, verdict or Your Turn beats, because the narration is the fellow's script exactly and the script has no lines for them.

portrait_layout.rule: In 9:16, all text and labels sit above 86% of the frame height (y < 0.86 * H), leaving the bottom 14% empty. Portrait text is at least 72 px at 2160x3840. Portrait type is large and labels are short.

metadata.fill_rule: Gate V needs content covering at least 55% of the safe area at 50% and at 85% of every beat. Each scene lays out its full cast early and holds it, and every scene is built to fill the frame.
metadata.gate_t_note: Gate T can read thin tick marks or outlines near text as letters. No thin ticks or outlines sit near text: dial ticks are pale and kept apart from labels, and cards that hold text use a soft border.
metadata.library_check: Searched with ./art scenes first: see SHOTLIST.md. Reused: ClaudeComposerAsk / ClaudeComposerAsk916 and LogoOutro / LogoOutro916; B01-B06 are custom Manim.
metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing
